We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the compound at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. We need to determine number of methyl groups (CH3) in the unknown molecule. We can use carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). Or proton NMR to see methyl proton signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals (integrations). But we don't have integration data, just spectra string. Might include peaks with multiplicity and integration.

We need to decide which tool to use. Use proton_nmr_spectra() to get 1H NMR. Then parse for methyl signals (chemical shift ~0.8-1.5 ppm, integration 3H). Count number of such signals.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
